{{Top|canon=Thermo-wrap}}
'''Thermal plastifoil survival blanket''',<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> sometimes referred to as thermal blanket or Therma-blanket, were designed to keep people warm. They were fairly large and were used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] [[Sleep/Legends|slept]] in a thin [[Color/Legends|gold]] thermal blanket in a [[Sleeper (furniture)|cot]] aboard [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|ship]], the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']].<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
